name: distributed-systems
description: Designing and mapping systems made of many services — the axiom set, the service map, and the reviewers that catch coupling and blast radius before a change ships.
$thinNote: ⚠️ This kit is THIN — two of its five skills are its own (microservices-architect, service-mapper) and three are borrowed from code-review. Said plainly rather than padded: a kit that looks full because it lists neighbouring skills is a worse answer than a small one that is honest. If distributed-systems is to be a first-class kit it needs content that does not exist in this repo yet.
